title.if-installed: CHECK DOOR PRESSURE Message on the FAP

dispcond.title: For cabin doors 1 and 4 only: Check of the associated door bottle pressure via the sight glass

requirement.para: One or more may be inoperative for cabin doors 1 and 4 provided that the associated door bottle pressure is checked via the sight glass before the first flight of each day.

dispcond.title: One inoperative and associated exit considered inoperative

requirement.para: One may be inoperative for 5 flights provided that the associated exit is considered inoperative. Item 52-10-01A Cabin Door

dispcond.title: For cabin doors 2 and 3: Check of the associated door bottle pressure

requirement.para: One or more may be inoperative provided that the associated door bottle pressure is checked before the first flight of each day.
